clinical_description: Routine nonfocal neurologic symptoms such as chronic headache or dizziness without a focal deficit
Known or suspected intracranial tumor metastasis or other enhancing brain lesion
Hyperacute focal neurologic deficit requiring an acute stroke MRI pathway
Known or suspected pituitary or sellar lesion with endocrine symptoms
Asymmetric sensorineural hearing loss tinnitus or vertigo requiring IAC assessment
Seizure focus localization or evaluation of recurrent focal seizures
Known or suspected multiple sclerosis or demyelinating disease
Cognitive decline or memory loss requiring a neurodegenerative-pattern assessment
Paroxysmal facial pain in a trigeminal nerve distribution
Hydrocephalus or suspected abnormal cerebrospinal-fluid dynamics
Treated or suspected high-grade glioma when perfusion assessment may distinguish tumor progression from treatment effect
Complex postoperative history uncertain implant compatibility or another request that cannot safely fit the simplified catalog
